endpoints.title: /api/ping - GET
endpoints.description: ping

endpoints.title: Add inventory to an opportunity
endpoints.description: Add items to an existing opportunity: Include the ID if you want to add inventory from your master list, or create a custom inventory through the Name. Each custom inventory created can also be added to the master inventory list if desired.

parameters.name: changeVolumeWeightCalculationMode
parameters.description: If true or not specified, the opportunity will be updated to calculate by inventory when items are added.

parameters.name: markAsNeedsReview
parameters.description: If true or not specified, the inventory will be marked as needing review

endpoints.title: Add materials to job
endpoints.description: Add packing materials to job based on its tariff. When using this endpoint, the materials added will overwrite the materials on the job, if there are any.

endpoints.title: Confirm a job
endpoints.description: Confirm a job by jobId and category (optional)

endpoints.title: Convert lead to opportunity
endpoints.description: Convert lead to opportunity

endpoints.title: Create a customer
endpoints.description: Create a customer

endpoints.title: Create a lead
endpoints.description: Submit a new lead to SmartMoving through the Premium API. Either ReferralSource or ReferralSourceId is required. For names, provide at least one of FullName, FirstName, or LastName.

endpoints.title: Create an opportunity
endpoints.description: Create an opportunity from scratch, indicating all the required fields. Continue to SmartMoving to get an estimate proposal sent to the customer, or retrieve the estimation from the Get opportunity details endpoint to handle the communication externally.

endpoints.title: Create follow-up
endpoints.description: Create follow-up for opportunityId

endpoints.title: Create job
endpoints.description: Create job for opportunity

endpoints.title: Create rooms
endpoints.description: Add new rooms to your lead or opportunity, and use it to load your job’s inventory.

endpoints.title: Delete follow-up by id
endpoints.description: Delete single follow-up for opportunityId and follow-up Id

endpoints.title: Delete job
endpoints.description: Remove job from opportunity

endpoints.title: Get affiliates
endpoints.description: Get all of your account's affiliates. Optionally filter by referral source or branch.

endpoints.title: Get all customers
endpoints.description: Get a list of all customers ordered by name. Optionally, you can filter them based on the job service date associated with each customer's opportunities. When filtered using service date(s), by default the opportunity info is included, to exclude it set IncludeOpportunityInfo = False.

endpoints.title: Get arrival windows
endpoints.description: Get all the arrival windows that are configured for your company, including their description, start time, and end time.

endpoints.title: Get audit activity for opportunity
endpoints.description: Get audit activity for opportunity

endpoints.title: Get bad lead reasons
endpoints.description: Get all of your company's bad lead reasons.

endpoints.title: Get branches
endpoints.description: Get all your company branches, alongside their dispatch location, and phone number.

endpoints.title: Get cancellation reasons
endpoints.description: Get all of your company's job cancellation reasons.

endpoints.title: Get crew member by Id
endpoints.description: Get the crew member details of one of the configured members in your account, including their contact information, role, branch, and compensation settings.

endpoints.title: Get crew members
endpoints.description: Get all crew members configured in your account, including their contact information, role, branch, and compensation settings.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: Filter by status: Active or Inactive

endpoints.title: Get customer by Id
endpoints.description: Get single customer by Id

endpoints.title: Get documents
endpoints.description: Get all (opportunity and job) documents for a given opportunity
endpoints.response_description: List of opportunity and job documents

endpoints.title: Get follow-up by id
endpoints.description: Get single follow-up for opportunityId and follow-up Id

endpoints.title: Get follow-ups
endpoints.description: Get all follow-ups for a given opportunity

endpoints.title: Get job by id
endpoints.description: Get job details by Id

endpoints.title: Get jobs by crew member id
endpoints.description: Retrieve jobs associated with a specific crew member, filtered by service date.

endpoints.title: Get jobs by opportunityId
endpoints.description: Get jobs by Opportunity Id

endpoints.title: Get lead by Id
endpoints.description: Get single lead by Id

endpoints.title: Get leads
endpoints.description: Retrieves leads created within a time range. By default, only New and In Progress leads are returned, but Lost and Bad Leads can be included through query parameters.

endpoints.title: Get leads by sales person Id
endpoints.description: Get leads by sales person Id

endpoints.title: Get lost lead/opportunity reasons
endpoints.description: Get all of your company's lost lead/opportunity reasons.

endpoints.title: Get master inventory list
endpoints.description: Get the master inventory list with all the relevant information, and use its IDs to add inventory items.

endpoints.title: Get materials by tariff id
endpoints.description: Get all your tariff’s packing materials information.

endpoints.title: Get move sizes
endpoints.description: Get all the move sizes that are stored in your company, alongside their description, cubic feet, and weight.

endpoints.title: Get opportunities by customer Id
endpoints.description: Get opportunities by customer Id

endpoints.title: Get opportunity details
endpoints.description: Get detailed information about an opportunity

parameters.name: IncludeJobAddresses
parameters.description: List of job’s addresses/stops, returned in the order they were stored going from Origin, to Destination.
